# Constant-weight EB resolvent removes the actual-prior penalty
2026-10-29. Analytic candidate; receiving review pending.

Suppose Φ=αB+(1−α)C, 0<α≤1, with B an EB CPTP channel and C CPTP. For any faithful actual prior σ, let R be its universal averaged rotated-Petz recovery for Φ. Then Ψ=RΦ fixesσ and decomposes as αE+(1−α)D, with E=RB EB CPTP and D=RC CPTP.

Define F=αΣ_(k≥0)(1−α)^k D^k E. Each term is EB, and its scalar weight isα(1−α)^k; the weights sum1. Therefore F is CPTP and EB. Let Q=(1−α)D. The series converges in diamond norm and ||(id−Q)^−1||diamond≤1/α. Exact composition algebra gives
id−F=(id−Q)^−1(id−Ψ).
Consequently, for anyρ and arbitrary quantum reference,
T(ρ,Fρ)≤α^−1T(ρ,Ψρ).
Universal recovery gives T(ρ,Ψρ)≤√ℓσ,Φ(ρ). Averaging an ensemble of actual meanσ yields
**e_avg(F)≤√δ/α**, δ=χ(ensemble)−χ(Φ ensemble), with NO barycenter penalty and NO stationarity requirement. The complete formulation requires product meanσ⊗ω_R, so the recovery factors. F⊗id_R is EB on A only.

## Uniform unital self-compatible qubits
The independently accepted Pauli-pairing construction in ../qubit_entropy_comparator_20261029/GOVERNING.md supplies such a decomposition with
α=1−s2≥1−1/√2
for every full-domain self-compatible UNITAL qubit channel, in its canonical unitary gauges. Its EB branch may be a convex combination of output-unitary conjugates of the same input dephasing, which is still EB. Thus
**e_avg(F)≤(2+√2)√δ**
for EVERY actual qubit prior, including coherent and nonstationary means, and the product-barycenter complete extension. This improves the prior-transfer scope of the original fixed-dephasing entropy proof. It does not preserve that fixed comparator; F is prior-adapted.

## Constructiveness and limits
The resolvent defines a convergent EB channel. At finite depthm, use the firstm terms and assign remaining probability(1−α)^m to any specified EB replacement channel; diamond error from F is at most2(1−α)^m, hence state trace error at most(1−α)^m. This is a mathematical finite-comparator approximation. Actual acquisition/preparation of R is not supplied; no cheap implementation or source-oracle inversion is asserted.

No arbitrary nonunital-channel, arbitrary correlated-barycenter, or many-noisy-qubit tensorization claim follows. Generalized universal recovery, EB closure under composition/mixture, and geometric resolvents are prior machinery; no his

# Mandatory support clarification
2026-10-29. Additive clarification; original governing file unchanged.

For the generic EB-mixture theorem, if ν=Φσ is rank deficient, let P=suppν. The primary recovery is TP on P. Extend it to the entire output algebra by R_ext(Y)=R(PYP)+Tr[(I−P)Y]σ. This is CPTP, agrees with recovery on all relevant outputs, and fixes the prior through R_extΦσ=σ. Use this extended recovery before calling R_extB and R_extC channels. For faithfulσ, every Φρ is supported in P. In particular every actual ensemble letter is covered. In the unital-qubit case, faithfulσ implies faithfulΦσ directly.

The general governing proof is stated for faithfulσ. To justify the unital-qubit conclusion for EVERY prior: a singular qubit prior is rank one, so every positive-weight ensemble letter equals that pure state. Constant re-preparation has zero error. In the product-reference version with meanσ_A⊗ω_R and rank-oneσ_A, positivity forces every letter to factor as σ_A⊗ρ_R,x; replacement on A again has zero disturbance. No singular Petz inverse is needed for this case.

# Independent receiving review: EB resolvent and actual-prior transfer

2026-10-29. Reviewer: review_finite_quantum_sampler. Verdict: PASS for the constant-weight CPTP-branch theorem, with SUPPORT_CLARIFICATION.md mandatory; PASS separately for the finite-depth TNI salvage. The rejected general left-resolvent normalization is correctly rejected. No unrestricted N371 closure, many-noisy-qubit tensorization, cheap recovery implementation or historical novelty is accepted.

## 1. Support and channel types
Let Phi:A->B have a decomposition alpha B_EB+(1-alpha)C into CPTP channels, alpha>0. For a faithful actual input prior sigma, the universal averaged rotated-Petz map R reverses Phi on the prior. It is TP on supp(Phi sigma). The requested mandatory clarification supplies an explicit CPTP extension outside that support: project onto it, apply R, and replace the orthogonal-complement trace by sigma. This is a CP instrument sum, not a coherent projection asserted to be lossless on arbitrary inputs. For faithful sigma every Phi(rho) is supported in supp(Phi sigma), so the extension does not change the relevant recovery theorem. In the unital qubit application Phi sigma is already faithful.

Hence E=R B_EB and D=R C are honest CPTP maps A->A, with E entanglement breaking. The recovered map Psi=R Phi fixes sigma and decomposes as alpha E+(1-alpha)D. At alpha=1 the argument reduces to F=E=Psi, without requiring a residual channel to be defined by division by zero.

## 2. Correct resolvent ordering and trace preservation
Set Q=(1-alpha)D. Since a CPTP map has diamond norm one, ||Q||diamond=1-alpha<1. Thus S=sum_(k>=0)Q^k converges in diamond norm with ||S||diamond<=1/alpha. F=S alpha E is a convex sum of EB CPTP channels D^k E with nonnegative scalar weights alpha(1-alpha)^k summing to one. It is therefore CPTP and EB. In finite dimensions EB closure also follows from the closed separable-Choi set. The order is E FIRST, followed by k uses of D, with k drawn from a geometric distribution; it is not a state-dependent first-hit stopping protocol.

The composition identity is

 id-Psi=(id-Q)-alpha E,
 S(id-Psi)=id-S alpha E=id-F.

There is no illicit commutation of E and D. Tensoring this linear identity with a reference and applying the diamond norm gives T(rho,F rho)<=alpha^-1 T(rho,Psi rho). Also (id-F)sigma=0, so the prior-adapted EB map fixes the actual prior even tho
